mapper.select: SELECT fr.id, fr.task_id, ft.task_no, fr.patient_id, p.name AS patient_name, fr.doctor_id, u.name AS doctor_name, fr.followup_date, fr.followup_type, fr.symptoms, fr.blood_pressure, fr.blood_sugar, fr.weight, fr.medication_compliance, fr.adverse_reactions, fr.lifestyle_guidance, fr.next_followup_date, fr.followup_result, fr.remarks FROM followup_record fr LEFT JOIN followup_task ft ON fr.task_id = ft.id LEFT JOIN patient p ON fr.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON fr.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN user u ON d.user_id = u.id WHERE fr.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO followup_record (task_id, patient_id, doctor_id, followup_date, followup_type, symptoms, blood_pressure, blood_sugar, weight, medication_compliance, adverse_reactions, lifestyle_guidance, next_followup_date, followup_result, remarks) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{followupDate}, #{followupType}, #{symptoms}, #{bloodPressure}, #{bloodSugar}, #{weight}, #{medicationCompliance}, #{adverseReactions}, #{lifestyleGuidance}, #{nextFollowupDate}, #{followupResult}, #{remarks})
